area: RECON 1 — Renderer & EXE patch mechanics (text-layout machinery in func 0x307DA0 / patch_exe.py P19/P22/P23)
findings: TWO-PEN ARCHITECTURE (the master fact). The universal R1188 renderer func 0x307DA0 maintains TWO horizontal stack slots per line: 0x1ce(sp) = the per-glyph ADVANCE accumulator (the running pen that grows by ADV[g] each glyph), and 0x1cc(sp) = a SECOND horizontal origin component. BOTH are zeroed at line start (0x30810C sh zero,0x1ce / 0x308114 sh zero,0x1cc) and BOTH feed the final draw-X. They are NOT interchangeable. Patch 23 wrote 0x1cc; the per-glyph advance that actually spreads narration text runs on 0x1ce.

(a) NARRATION mode-2/align-dispatch origin @0x308328 — Patch 23 mechanics, DECODED. The X-dispatcher at 0x3082DC reads align = lbu a1,0x2a7(a0). Live narration has align==0 (proven by prior recon), so 0x3082E4 `bne a1,1` jumps to the align!=1 block at 0x308308. That block: 0x308310 lh a0,0x1cc(sp); 0x308314-0x30831C compute a1 = count(a2)*12 via sll1/addu/sll2; 0x308320/0x308324 are dsll32/dsra32 (sign-extend a1 to 16-bit). THEN 0x308328 (Patch 23, *PATCHED* to `li a0,8` / 0x24040008) — this DISCARDS the count*12 result in a1 and forces a0=8; 0x30832C `b 0x308380`; 0x308330 sh a0,0x1cc(sp) stores 8. So Patch 23 sets pen-0x1cc = constant 8. a0 is NOT clobbered between 0x308328 and the store — the branch+delay-slot store fire immediately. The pristine instruction there was `subu a0,a0,a1` (0x00852023 = pen - count*12).

(a) WHY NARRATION STILL CLIPS OFF-LEFT — the load-bearing truth. The final narration draw-X is built at 0x309730-0x309774: v0 = pen0x1cc(=8) + glyph.[0xa]; v0 = v0 + (desc.[0x3e](s0+0x3e) + 0x130(sp)); this v0 is the X that goes to draw fn 0x3060B0 (via t2=v0<<4 in the delay slot @0x30977C). SEPARATELY, the 0x1ce ADVANCE pen feeds t4 = (advance - LEFTSHIFT[g]) + glyph.[0x8] + desc.[0x3c] + t0, which becomes t1=t4<<4 — i.e. the 0x1ce pen IS part of the horizontal coordinate too (t4 carries the per-glyph rightward flow). So horizontal position = f(0x1cc constant=8) + f(0x1ce advancing pen) + box origins desc.[0x3c]/[0x3e] + sp+0x130. Patch 23 only pinned 0x1cc=8; it did NOT establish the box-LEFT. If desc.[0x3c]/[0x3e]/sp+0x130 (the real box-left contributions) are small/zero and the 0x1ce-derived t4 term or the centering it replaced were the only left-anchor, text starts at ~8px but the advancing pen path can still drive glyphs to negative screen-X. CONCLUSION: 0x308328 is the centering site for pen-0x1cc only; it is NOT the sole origin. The genuine box-left for narration is the combination of desc+0x3c (s0+0x3c, read @0x30973C), desc+0x3e (s0+0x3e, read @0x309740), and sp+0x130 (read @0x309768) — these MUST be read from live RAM (the descriptor at 0x565150[0]=0x1137AC0) to know the actual penX. Patch 23's +8 is a byte-correct edit on the wrong contributor (same failure class as v121 Patch 21).

(a) Narration ADVANCE pen confirmed = 0x1ce. Patch-14 Stage-1 cave @0x4C7540 (hooked at 0x3097A0) does: andi v1,s1,0xFF (gid); lbu v1,ADV[0x7564](0x4C0000); lh v0,0x1ce(sp); addu v0,v0,v1; sh v0,0x1ce(sp). Patch-14 Stage-2 draw-shift cave @0x4C7670 (hooked at 0x309750) does: lbu at,LEFTSHIFT[0x7690]; subu a3,a3,at (a3 = the 0x1ce value loaded @0x309738); addu t4,a3,t4. So narration spacing is fully proportional on 0x1ce and is INDEPENDENT of Patch 23's 0x1cc edit.

(b) CHARGEN Block1 advance @0x308040 + Patch 19 — hook & gate VERIFIED INSTALLED AND CORRECT ON PAPER. 0x308040 is *PATCHED* to `j 0x4D6600` (0x08135980); delay slot 0x308044 (orig sh v0,0x1cc(sp)) -> nop (*PATCHED*). 0x308018 is *PATCHED* to `j 0x4D6660` (0x08135998, Stage-2 draw-shift). Cave1 @0x4D6600 reads `lw at,-0x62d8(gp)` (screen mode RAM 0x4FED18), `li t0,5`, `bne at,t0,0x4D6630` (stock 24px fallback), `srl v1,v1,8` (gid = HIGH byte of cell lh 0x40(s1)), index ADV @0x7564, `lh v0,0x1cc(sp); addu v0,v0,t0; sh v0,0x1cc(sp); j 0x308048`. The mode-5 gate and high-byte gid read are CORRECT. So Patch 19 DOES execute for chargen text IF screen-mode global ==5 at that moment.

(b) WHY CHARGEN SPACES STILL LOOK MONOSPACED-WIDE — the suspect. The chargen pen is 0x1cc(sp), advanced proportionally by cave1. But the chargen DRAW is `jal 0x305E30` (0x308030), a DIFFERENT draw fn than narration's 0x3060B0. The draw-X for chargen is built at 0x308010-0x30802C: t0=desc.[0x3e](s0+0x3e); a1=v0 (glyph metric from jal 0x2ED670); v0=t0+s7 (s7 = count*12 reserve @0x307FF0!); t0=v1+v0. Note s7 is STILL count*12 (Patch 19 intentionally did NOT hook Stage-3, per the v122 comment, on the theory the count*12 reserve cancels). Stage-2 draw-shift cave @0x4D6660 only adjusts penX (0x1cc) by LEFTSHIFT. THE LIKELY BUG: if at chargen-draw time the screen-mode global is NOT 5 (e.g. the name/stat INPUT boxes run under a different mode value than the chargen prompt screen), cave1 takes the `bne at,t0` stock branch -> `addiu v0,v0,0x18` = 24px monospace, exactly the symptom. Patch 19's gate firing must be confirmed against the chargen.p2s eeMemory value of 0x4FED18 AT THE INPUT-BOX moment — the prompt screen (mode==5) and the input boxes may differ. This is the open question that explains 'Patch 19 did nothing visible'.

(c) REQUEST body Block2 advance @0x308CB0/0x308D7C — Patch 22 VERIFIED. Both sites *PATCHED* to `addiu v0,v0,0x12` (18px), operating on pen 0x1ce(sp) (0x308CAC lh v0,0x1ce; 0x308CB8 sh v0,0x1ce). The horizontal centering reserve idiom @0x30896C/0x308974 is *PATCHED* (sll v0,a0,3 / sll v0,v0,1 = a0*18); it computes the X origin stored to 0x1ce @0x308988. So Patch 22 changes only the HORIZONTAL advance and horizontal centering — it does NOTHING to vertical line pitch.

(c) REQUEST vertical OVERLAP root region. Request Block2 draw-X is built @0x308C38-0x308C4C reading BOTH pens (v0=0x1ce X-advance, t1=0x1cc) + box origins s0.[0x3c]/s0.[0x3e] — same dual-pen structure as narration. The per-line VERTICAL position is governed by the line counter at 0x180(sp) (incremented @0x308358/0x308900) and the box-origin Y in the descriptor, NOT by anything in the 0x308968-0x308A20 block (that block is the 0xFFF0-0xFFF5 control-code dispatch, jal 0x1BFC30). The vertical overlap (lines on top of each other) is therefore NOT an EXE-arithmetic bug in this region; it is driven by how many WRAPPED lines the body produces vs the fixed box height + per-line Y pitch. The line COUNT is set by build_v9.py wrap (NARRATION_BOX_PX/DIALOGUE_BOX_PX wrap budget) interacting with the 18px advance — if wrap still assumes ~24px it under-wraps, producing lines that overrun and the renderer wraps/overdraws them at the same Y. This needs the live request descriptor (requestdesc.p2s) line count + box-height read, plus the build/build_v9.py wrap_px value used for the request body.

PS2 DECODER NOTE: build/_recon_2f2490/dec.py does NOT decode PS2 64-bit shifts (funct 0x3C=dsll32, 0x3F=dsra32, 0x3A=dsrl, 0x38=dsll) — they print as 'R funct=0x3c'. These appear constantly as 16-bit sign-extension idioms (dsll32 r,r,16 / dsra32 r,r,16) around every sh of a coordinate. Any agent using dec.py must extend it (I patched a local copy) or it will misread the origin arithmetic.
